sample_unit: EMS clinical charts (18,402 lines of clinical information)

links.outcome: Accuracy detecting epinephrine adverse safety events versus baseline LLMs, using ontology and strict rules
links.effect: SAFE-AI reached 97.9% accuracy for epinephrine overdoses and 91.6% for delays in epinephrine administration, greatly outperforming baseline LLMs.
links.quote: We tested SAFE-AI against these labels, achieving similar performance to human experts in detecting epinephrine overdoses with 97.9% accuracy, and 91.6% accuracy in identifying delays in epinephrine administration, greatly outperforming baseline LLMs models.

unlisted_practices: Ontology-driven, expert-rule-constrained LLM agent to detect adverse safety events in medical charts

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an ontology-driven agentic LLM architecture (SAFE-AI) on retrospective EMS clinical records to detect adverse safety events, comparing it to baseline LLMs and clinician review.
